intended_object: The standard (flat) continuous Hermitian metric on the trivial vector bundle B × V, given fiberwise by the inner product of the model inner-product space V (from the docstring and name).
explanation: At every point the body uses `innerSL 𝕜`, the inner product of V, as a continuous sesquilinear form. The structure's other fields hold for standard reasons. Hermitian symmetry is `inner_conj_symm`. Positivity holds because ⟪v,v⟫ = ‖v‖² > 0 for v ≠ 0. The bounded-sublevel field holds because the set {⟪v,v⟫ < 1} is the open unit ball of V. Continuity holds because the section is constant in the trivialization of the trivial bundle. The generality is natural: any RCLike 𝕜, any topological base B, any inner product space V, with no finite-dimensionality or completeness needed. Mathlib has no Hermitian metric structure; its closest analogue is the real-only Prop-valued instance `IsContinuousRiemannianBundle F₁ (Bundle.Trivial B F₁)`, so there is no broader Mathlib counterpart.
